top_signals.title: No US-Iran Talks Planned, Hormuz Remains Closed
top_signals.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday no talks were taking place with Iran and none were scheduled, and he insisted that the Strait of Hormuz was open, contradicting an earlier Iranian assertion that the critical waterway remained shut…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bond yields are climbing. Here’s what that means for mortgages and other consumer borrowing
top_signals.summary: Long-term government bond yields have risen sharply in recent days. Higher bond yields push consumer borrowing costs up, sometimes immediately.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
